visual.issue: The month tabs' 'Used' progress bars and the Savings goals bars are data-bar conditional formats, which Google Sheets does not support. Google buyers (the title's first app) would see only percentages, while photo 5 promises 'a bar per category'. This follows from the Sheets feature set and was not tested in Sheets.
Paycheck plan has only 27 payday rows. Weekly pay ends after 27 paydays (July 2 from Jan 1, or about 6 months from a typed date) with no note, so the rest of the year is missing.
Debt payoff 'Extra each month' ($100, shaded input) is used by no formula. Typing an extra amount changes nothing, which looks broken, and the subtitle says the timelines update.

Ready check 'Example cleared' looks for the example's 'What' text (Rent, Weekly shop, Streaming, Phone bill, Shoes...). A buyer who logs their own January 'Rent' stays at To do, 'Clear the example in January', forever.
Month summary labels Spent, Left over and Saved and debt paid are in the input shade but locked, which contradicts the colour key 'shaded = type here'.
Bills nav row is cramped: 'Paycheck' is cut to 'Payche' and runs into 'Debt'; 'Dashboard Setup' touch. The same shows in photo 7.
Wrapped header text is clipped at the bottom: Paycheck plan 'Bills due before next payday' and 'Left from this paycheck', Debt payoff 'Months at minimum'.
The Setup photo crops off Total budget and Left to budget, yet its bullet and alt text claim 'Left to budget at $0'.
The hero crops the pie chart in half and the bar chart is not in frame; the alt text claims both charts.

Extras photo: the Debt card is cut at the right ('Inter...'); the Savings card is cut ('Dec 202', no Save per month column) though the bullet says 'save per month'; the Bills card shows no paid marks though the bullet says 'paid mark each month'; Bills text is about 10px at 2700px.
2x2 'inside' grid thumbnails have about 5-6px text at native 2700px: the Start here steps, Setup rows and January log are unreadable even zoomed.
Save per month uses DATEDIF(TODAY(),target) with no IFERROR; once a goal's target month passes the cell shows #NUM!.

All 176 nav and jump links are stored as External hyperlinks with target "#'Sheet'!A1" instead of internal location links. Excel follows them; whether Google Sheets converts them on import is unverified, and they are the whole navigation system.
